svg.title: Jobs within 60 minutes by public transport, São Paulo
svg.desc: A map of the municipality of São Paulo covered by cells coloured by the share of the city's formal jobs reached within 60 minutes by walking and public transport at the morning peak. The centre and the south-west, where the jobs are, reach the most; access falls towards the far east, the far south and the north. Half the residents reach 8.1% of the jobs or less.

g.text: Share of the municipality's 3,461,972 formal jobs reached from each cell,
walking and riding, at the morning peak (median of departures 07:00–07:59,
Tuesday 17 November 2026). Half the residents reach 8.1% or less.
Jobs within an hour by public transport, São Paulo
Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). GTFS: SPTrans, as fetched by the Mobility Database on 12 November 2026.
Cells, population (Censo 2010) and jobs (RAIS 2019): Ipea, Access to Opportunities Project (aopdata).
